newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle up sharply, fast on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle up sharply, fast on short-covering.

text.p: CME live cattle futures rallied sharply in fast trade on short covering and buy-stop orders, floor traders said.
The market held technical support despite weak cash markets.
Buy-stop orders were located around 64.000 cents per lb in August, traders said. That month rose to 64.875 cts per lb.
Notable buyers were RBH and R.J. O'Brien, traders said.
At 1250 CDT, August cattle were 1.15 cents higher at 64.900, and other months were 0.45 to 0.80 cent higher.
